id.description: Stable record identity within this generated release. The shipped v1.1.0 generator derives it from source filename stem plus the documented synthetic anchor and fails on collisions.

kind.description: Semantic record kind. The shipped v1.1.0 generator currently emits section records; other enum values are reserved for compatible future tooling.

anchor.description: Synthetic extraction selector documented in FORMAT2.md; not necessarily a literal Markdown/GitHub fragment.

links.description: Non-exhaustive retrieval hints. Load-bearing local § references may also be present only in text and are resolved by the FORMAT2.md local-section resolver.

text.description: Complete machine-consumable semantic text for the extracted record granularity; not an excerpt-only search hint.
